_metadata.description: Plans bind targets to destinations with schedule and retention; the scheduler runs them.

requirements.title: Many-to-many plans with schedule and retention
requirements.description: A plan binds one or more targets to one or more destinations and carries a schedule and a retention policy. One target may belong to multiple plans (e.g. daily-to-local and weekly-to-offsite).

validation.notes: Create a plan spanning multiple targets/destinations; assert a target can appear in two plans.

requirements.title: Scheduled and on-demand execution
requirements.description: An in-process scheduler triggers plan runs on their cadence; operators and scenarios can trigger a run on demand. No external orchestrator (no n8n).

validation.notes: Advance a fake clock to fire a due plan; assert a run is created; assert manual trigger creates a run immediately.
